messages:
sam: RFC idea — formalize an exit gate for v1 so retirements are predictable. quick sync?
maya: yes please. rough bullets?
sam: rough: (1) telemetry signal thresholds, (2) quota/billing guardrails, (3) routing fallback policy, (4) console gating + tenant UX, (5) runbook + automatic rollbacks.
andre: can you expand the telemetry part? what exact signals? :eyes:
sam: sure. propose: - request success rate >= 99.5% (v2 vs v1 parity) - mean latency P95 within 1.2x of v1 for resident tenants - semantic regression: sampled prompts eval pass rate >= 98% over 24h
sam: sampling query (pseudo):
```
SELECT sample_id, prompt_hash, model_variant, success, latency_ms
FROM telemetry.requests
WHERE time > now() - interval '24 hours'
AND cohort = 'v1-migration-probe'
LIMIT 10000;
```
jules: how big should the probe cohort be? 0.1% will be noisy. 1% maybe?
li: i'd push 0.5–1% depending on tenant size. target 10k samples/day per major tenant.
maya: for quotas — we need to avoid unexpected billing spikes when clients switch to v2. mapping rules?
sam: mapping idea: map v1 token usage -> v2 estimated tokens via historical compression ratio per model; put a temporary quota multiplier cap (max 2x) during migration. console shows "estimated v2 token impact" before flip.
andre: do we have compression ratios per model in telemetry?
li: yes — we already compute median token_ratio by model in metrics.model_token_ratio. can serve to precompute tenant impact.
carla: console UX: add per-tenant deprecation banner + opt-in toggle "force v2" with preview of estimated cost/diff. Also show a red/amber/green health indicator based on telemetry thresholds.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary group created: cohort=v1-migration-probe size=0.75% — started at 1755560000
maya: routing policy: prefer sticky token affinity for 7 days after a tenant flip, then re-evaluate. helps session continuity.
andre: fallback: if error spike > 0.7% for 15m, route that token back to v1 automatically and alert the tenant owner. automatic rollback window 30m, manual review required for longer.
sam: good. add quota backstop: if mapped-cost > 1.5x baseline for a tenant in 1h, throttle to baseline + 10% and notify billing team.
jules: telemetry dashboards: need a dedicated "migration health" dashboard per tenant, with P95, success_rate, semantic_regressions, token_ratio, cost_estimate.
li: will add backend signals and a summary widget. need the event schema for cohort marking: `migration_cohort:true` on requests.
carla: also add a console action: "Run migration dry-run" which simulates routing decisions for a tenant and shows expected traffic split.
maya: runbook: steps for engineers on-call. include steps: revert routing, revoke cohort flag, escalate to infra team, attach trace IDs.
sam: final ask: agree thresholds? telemetry parity 99.5% + latency P95 <=1.2x + semantic eval >=98% + probe cohort 0.5–1% + rollback triggers as above. thumbs?
andre: +1
jules: +1
li: +1
maya: +1
carla: I'll draft the runbook and console mocks today.
sam: awesome — i'll PR the RFC and add the dashboard requirements. thanks all :+1:
